rows.ARS:
Medium pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: TANschaubud
Exhibition name: Duftrausch ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, before 1985).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1986 as 'Senteur Royale'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink. Strong, damask fragrance. 40 to 50 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very full (41+ petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Armed with thorns / prickles, bushy, upright. Matte, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 32" (60 to 80cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
rows.Patents:
Australia - Patent No: 96 on 7 Jan 1991
Application No: 1990/033 on 19 Feb 1990 VIEW PBR PATENT
Synonym: Olde Fragrance. Applicant: Rosen Tantau.

The breeder was Hans-Jurgen Evers of Rosen-Tantau, Uetersen, West Germany. ‘Tanschaubud’ was selected from the progeny of a controlled pollination of two unnamed seedlings. Plant Variety Rights have been granted in West Germany in 1985.

Patent expired.
